messages.subject: Presenting new shinyCleave package
parts:
Hello,

I recently needed some new input types for my shiny apps. Using the Cleave.js library, I created a package that allows for customized text-inputs like phone-numbers, credit cards, formatted numbers, and other options like prefixs. The package is still in its infancy, so I would greatly appreciate feedback.

https://github.com/carlganz/shinyCleave

Kind Regards,
Carl Ganz
